photos.description: Front view of the target building with six visible front openings.
Right-side view showing the sloping roof edge, one elevated window, one low opening and rising street grade.
Wide left-side view showing the target, a raised timber deck, an upper window, a lower opening and an adjacent neighboring building.
Closer left-side view showing the same upper window, exterior stair, low exterior volume and timber deck.
Rear-left oblique view showing the exterior stair, low exterior volume, recurring side window and neighboring weathered structure.
